response.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END AS state, COUNT(*) AS matched_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_of_all_records FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END

assumptions.assumption: Blank strings and NULL states belong to one group, shown as NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Blank strings and NULL states are separate groups.
